_comment: SYNTHETIC. Corrected 2026-08-02: `url` was ABSENT here, which no real
response ever is. routes.py's _live_preview_absent() sets url
unconditionally — it is a static route path, not a per-frame value — so
the no-frame payload carries source: null AND a url that 404s.
The mismatch hid a real defect: PreviewCard guarded on `url` to decide
whether to render an , which was correct against this fixture and
wrong against the server, so the card showed a broken-image icon instead
of its honest absent state. Found by looking at the live screen.
